description.zh: ECI实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入。
description.en: The IDs of the ECI instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

description.zh:
事件源。取值范围：

- EciService
- K8sAgent

默认为空，查询所有事件。
description.en:
The event source. Valid values:

- EciService

- K8sAgent

If you leave this parameter empty, all events are queried.

description.zh:
限定此次返回资源（ECI实例）的数量。默认为200个。

> 返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
description.en:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. Default value: 200.

> The response may contain fewer entries than the specified value.

description.zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。

首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取。
description.en:
The token that is used to start the next query. If this parameter is left empty, no more data is returned.

You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. Obtain the token for subsequent queries from the response.

description.zh: 返回最近几秒内新增的事件，用于轮询增量事件。
description.en: Returns only new events to enable incremental polling.
The tags that are attached to the ECI instances.
The tag key of the ECI instance.
The tag value of the ECI instance.

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口可以同时查询多个ECI实例的事件信息。默认返回每个ECI实例最新的50条事件信息。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to query events for multiple ECI instances. By default, the 50 latest event records for each ECI instance are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-container-group-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-k --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --resource-group-id rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --container-group-ids eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000 --tag Value=name Key=test --next-token d78f2dd8-5979-42fe-xaee-b16db43be5bc --event-source K8sAgent --since-second 60 --limit 200 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci DescribeContainerGroupEvents --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --EventSource K8sAgent --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-k' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000' --ContainerGroupIds 'eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000' --NextToken 'd78f2dd8-5979-42fe-xaee-b16db43be5bc' --VSwitchId 'vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000' --Tag.1.Value name --SinceSecond 60 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Limit 200
